public_rationale: The arithmetic works: the stated inputs produce $82.08 billion. That alone does not validate the financial estimate. The historical $41.4 billion received total and compatible capex inputs were not independently verified.
limitations: The allocation percentage is an explicit assumption.
Funding and partner-owned infrastructure are not a standard measure of OpenAI's realized cost.
The historical funding database was inaccessible.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Attributing 30% of Microsoft's capex since 2024 and adding OpenAI's $41.4B in funding, OpenAI's true cost is about $82 billion.

statement.excerpt: Based on my (conservative) calculations, the true "cost" of OpenAI is around $82 billion, and that only includes capex from 2024 onward, based on 30% of Microsoft's capex (as not everything has been invested yet in 2025, and OpenAI is not necessarily all of the capex) and the $41.4 billion of funding it’s received so far.
